name: Wemic
sourceDistinctions: The 2003 player entry gives 5 racial Hit Dice, LA +3, and a weapon plus one secondary claw. The earlier monster uses two secondary claws with a weapon.
The 2004 conversion confirms 10-ft. space and 5-ft. reach. It updates the earlier monster’s skills and sample feats.
The player entry specifies twice Medium carrying limits. This profile retains that line. The core Large quadruped table gives a general three-times multiplier.
The 3.5 Jump rule gives a separate +4 at speed 40 ft. in addition to the Wemic’s +8 racial bonus. The earlier AD&D fixed leap distances are a separate ruleset.
portraitForm: Tavaro Sunmane, an original Wemic gully guide
